lines.en: label library40:
scene futabaphonemom1
The morning starts off the same as any other.
lines.zh: 早晨的开端和往常没什么两样。

lines.en: I get out of bed.
lines.zh: 我起床。

lines.en: I get dressed.
lines.zh: 我穿好衣服。

lines.en: I leave the house.
lines.zh: 我出门。

lines.en: And I decide to waste my day away with someone who did not ask for me, but will receive me nonetheless.
lines.zh: 然后我决定把这一天浪费在一个并没有要求我出现、但终究还是会接纳我的人身上。

lines.en: Someone who, just recently, made a minor decision to keep me at arm’s length in favor of temporary comfort, something I simultaneously admire and abhor.
lines.zh: 一个就在不久前做了个小决定、把我推到一臂之外、好换取暂时的安心的人——对这件事我既欣赏又厌恶。

lines.en: I admire it because it shows that Futaba is becoming her own person.
lines.zh: 我欣赏，是因为这说明 Futaba 正在成为她自己。

lines.en: That Kumon-mi is a giant eggshell and she’s finally starting to pip her way out of it.
lines.zh: 说明 Kumon-mi 是一枚巨大的蛋壳，而她终于开始一点点啄破了。

lines.en: But I abhor it because she is supposed to be imprinted on me.
lines.zh: 我厌恶，是因为她本该被刻上我的印记。

lines.en: And also because I wanted to see those giant “assets” of hers in action as she ran on the treadmill.
lines.zh: 也因为我本来还指望能看她那对巨大的「本钱」在跑步机上动起来的样子。

lines.en: Combine that with the fact that I’ve been standing here for roughly five minutes now without being noticed and...
lines.zh: 再配上我已经在这儿站了大概五分钟却还没被注意到这个事实……

lines.en: Yeah. Forgive me if I wind up harboring some unwarranted, internal resentment for at least a day or two.
lines.zh: 是啊。接下来一两天里我要是心里藏着点没来由的怨气，还请见谅。

lines.en: Basically, everyone is free to do as they want. But everyone else is free to react to those decisions however {i}they{/i} want.
lines.zh: 基本上，谁都有想做什么就做什么的自由。但{i}别人{/i}也有对这些决定随意作出反应的自由。

lines.en: Am I making a bigger deal out of this than I should be considering it was just one thing that happened one time?
lines.zh: 明明只是一件事、只发生过一次，我是不是把它看得太重了？

lines.en: Yes. Absolutely. There is no question about it.
lines.zh: 是的。绝对是。这一点毫无疑问。

lines.en: But if you think that is irrational, I implore you to reconsider how much I enjoy the female body and that this is nothing short of a traumatic experience for me.
lines.zh: 不过你要是觉得这不理性，我劝你重新想想我有多么热爱女性的身体——这对我来说不亚于一场心理创伤。

lines.en: Oh well, though.
lines.zh: 算了，无所谓。

lines.en: I’ll just have her take her clothes off in private whenever she’s off the phone.
lines.zh: 等她不在打电话的时候，我再让她私下把衣服脱掉就是了。

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: No, I’m doing okay. How are you?
lines.zh: : 不，我没事。你呢？

lines.en: : Still?
lines.zh: : 还在？

lines.en: : I thought you said it would be possible for you to come visit, though? Didn’t you just need some sort of pass?
lines.zh: : 可你不是说你有可能过来看我吗？你不是只需要弄到某种通行证吗？

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom2
: Oh, no. Not at all. I don’t need anything.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。完全不用。我什么都不缺。

lines.en: : I’ve been saving basically everything you send me anyway since the dorm is free and-
lines.zh: : 反正你寄给我的东西我基本都存着呢，因为宿舍是免费的，而且——

lines.en: : ...Yeah. I’m still with Rin.
lines.zh: : ……嗯。我还和 Rin 在一起。

lines.en: : Yeah. She’s doing a lot better.
lines.zh: : 嗯。她好多了。

lines.en: : Nodoka is actually here too now.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 现在其实也在这儿了。

lines.en: : Yes, she...is still Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 是啊，她……还是那个 Nodoka。

lines.en: : My teacher?
lines.zh: : 我的老师？

lines.en: : He’s-
: Instructing you on how to properly pleasure a man.
lines.zh: : 在教你如何正确地取悦男人。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom3
: HE’S FINE!
lines.zh: : 他很好！

lines.en: : Mom, I’ve gotta go now. Someone just showed up to the library and-
lines.zh: : 妈，我得挂了。刚有人来图书馆了，而且——

lines.en: : Yes! I told you, I’m fine!
lines.zh: : 是！我都说了，我很好！

lines.en: : Tell her about our “lessons.”
lines.zh: : 跟她说说我们的「课程」啊。

lines.en: : Bye, Mom! Love you!
lines.zh: : 再见，妈！我爱你！

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom4
: Good morning.
lines.zh: : 早上好。

lines.en: : Yes. Good morning.
lines.zh: : 嗯。早上好。

lines.en: : You should have let me talk to her.
lines.zh: : 你刚才应该让我跟她说话的。

lines.en: : I would have absolutely let you talk to her if the first thing out of your mouth wasn’t about our “lessons.”
lines.zh: : 要是你开口第一句不是我们的「课程」，我绝对会让你跟她说的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Futaba. I just can’t look at you without being overcome by lust and excitement.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，Futaba。我只要看着你，就会被欲望和兴奋冲昏头脑。

lines.en: : You can’t look at {i}anything{/i} without being overcome by those feelings...
lines.zh: : 你看着{i}什么东西{/i}都会被那种感觉冲昏头脑吧……

lines.en: : And you are no exception to that.
lines.zh: : 而你也不例外。

lines.en: : Why were you talking to your mom?
lines.zh: : 你为什么在跟你妈妈打电话？

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom5
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because...she’s my mom.
lines.zh: : 因为……她是我妈啊。

lines.en: : I don’t think I really need a reason other than that, do I?
lines.zh: : 我想除了这个之外，我也不需要别的理由了吧？

lines.en: : I guess not. I’ve just never seen you talking to her before.
lines.zh: : 大概是不需要。我只是从没见过你跟她打电话。

lines.en: : Do you not talk to your parents often, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你不太常跟父母联系吗？

lines.en: : I don’t have any parents.
lines.zh: : 我没有父母。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom6
: Wait, you weren’t...adopted like Rin, were you?
lines.zh: : 等等，你该不会……是像 Rin 那样被收养的吧？

lines.en: : No. I just have zero recollection of my non-Ami family. So it’s essentially the same thing as not having parents.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是对除了 Ami 以外的家人毫无记忆。所以本质上跟没有父母没什么两样。

lines.en: : That’s...not exactly the same thing.
lines.zh: : 那……不完全是一回事。

lines.en: : They might be really worried about you.
lines.zh: : 他们说不定很担心你。

lines.en: : Or dead.
lines.zh: : 也可能已经死了。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom7
: R-Right...
: Or dead...
lines.zh: : 也可能已经死了……

lines.en: : Way I look at it is that I have no need for them, so them not existing isn’t really a big deal.
lines.zh: : 我的看法是，我不需要他们，所以他们不存在也不是什么大不了的事。

lines.en: : I’m sure it saves me a lot of time too since I don’t have to talk to them on the phone while other people are waiting for me.
lines.zh: : 我敢说这还替我省了不少时间，毕竟我不用在别人等着我的时候跟他们讲电话。

lines.en: : Sensei, I’m not going to apologize for talking to my Mom instead of you.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我不会因为跟我妈打电话、没理你而道歉的。

lines.en: : First the gym, now this?
lines.zh: : 先是健身房，现在又是这个？

lines.en: : Futaba...do you hate me?
lines.zh: : Futaba……你讨厌我吗？

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom8
: Of course not...you’re no less important to me at this point than Rin or Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 当然不……到了现在，你对我来说不比 Rin 或 Nodoka 次要。

lines.en: : Well, actually, you’re a little less important to me than them. But that’s only because I’ve known them for a lot longer and...
lines.zh: : 好吧，其实你比她们次要一点点。但那只是因为我和她们认识得久得多，而且……

lines.en: : And I...still don’t totally understand what’s going on between us...
lines.zh: : 而且我……还是不太明白我们之间到底算什么……

lines.en: : If you take your clothes off, I’d be happy to remind you.
lines.zh: : 你要是肯把衣服脱了，我很乐意帮你回忆起来。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom9
: Uhh...no. I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。不用了。

lines.en: scene black
Futaba hates me now and our relationship is over.
lines.zh: Futaba 现在讨厌我了，我们的关系完蛋了。

lines.en: I go home and spend the rest of the day wallowing in sadness and self-pity.
lines.zh: 我回家，在悲伤和自怜里泡完剩下的一天。

lines.en: : Sensei...can you please open your eyes?
lines.zh: : Sensei……你能睁开眼睛吗？

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom9
: Yes. But not because you asked me to. Because it is unsafe to keep them closed when there are wild animals out here that could tear me to shreds at any given moment.
lines.zh: : 好。但不是因为你让我睁的。是因为外面有野兽，随时可能把我撕成碎片，闭着眼睛不安全。

lines.en: : We live in suburban Japan...there isn’t any wild animal that is going to attack you out of nowhere like that.
lines.zh: : 我们住在日本的郊区……哪有什么野兽会突然窜出来袭击你啊。

lines.en: : I’m keeping my eyes open just in case.
lines.zh: : 我还是睁着以防万一。

lines.en: : R-Right...
scene futabaphonemom10
: Umm...anyway...I’m kind of glad that you showed up this morning because I...
lines.zh: : 嗯……对了……我其实挺高兴你今天早上过来的，因为我……

lines.en: : Wanted to tell you a little about how the other night went. Since I...made you leave and stuff.
lines.zh: : 想跟你说一说那天晚上的情况。毕竟我……让你走了之类的。

lines.en: : Sure. What’s there to say, though?
lines.zh: : 好啊。不过有什么好说的呢？

lines.en: : Figured you three just...did gym stuff for an hour or two and went back home.
lines.zh: : 我以为你们三个就……在健身房折腾一两个小时，然后就回家了。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom11
: That’s exactly right. We did gym stuff for an hour or two and then went back home.
lines.zh: : 一点没错。我们练了一两个小时就回家了。

lines.en: : But...since it was just Rin and Nodoka...I was less worried about...looking like an idiot and...
lines.zh: : 不过……因为只有 Rin 和 Nodoka……我就没那么担心……自己看起来像个傻瓜，而且……

lines.en: : I don’t know. I think I maybe even felt a little good afterwards.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我觉得结束后我甚至还有点舒服。

lines.en: : Obviously nothing has really changed yet since it was only one day, but...yeah.
lines.zh: : 显然才一天，什么都没真正改变，不过……嗯。

lines.en: : I wanted to let you know that...I didn’t just...cry the entire time after you left.
lines.zh: : 我想告诉你……你走了之后我没有……光顾着哭。

lines.en: : I actually...followed through and tried to make myself better.
lines.zh: : 我真的……坚持了下来，试着让自己好起来。

lines.en: if bookdate == True:
scene futabaphonemom10
: Do you...remember when the two of us went to the bookstore together?
lines.zh: : 你……还记得我们俩一起去书店那次吗？

lines.en: : And how I...kind of confessed my feelings for you?
lines.zh: : 还有我……算是向你告白那次？

lines.en: : It wasn’t “kind of.” You made it very apparent that you’re falling in love with me.
lines.zh: : 不是「算是」。你把「你正在爱上我」表现得非常明显。

lines.en: : And you made it very apparent that focusing on things like that isn’t productive if I can’t accept who I am first.
lines.zh: : 而你也把「在我先接纳自己之前，把心思放在那种事上没有意义」表现得非常明显。

lines.en: : The thing is, though...I don’t want to accept who I am. I want to be somebody else.
lines.zh: : 可是问题是……我不想接纳我自己。我想成为另一个人。

lines.en: else:
: What is “better,” though? What’s so hard about accepting who you are?
lines.zh: : 但什么才算「更好」呢？接纳自己有那么难吗？

lines.en: : Who I am isn’t who I want to be. That’s the issue.
lines.zh: : 我是谁，和我想成为谁不一样。问题就在这里。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom11
: If I could wake up in the morning and see someone with Rin’s body...or Chika’s body...or basically anyone else’s body, I’d be a lot more comfortable stepping outside.
lines.zh: : 如果早上醒来，我能看到自己长着 Rin 的身体……或者 Chika 的身体……或者基本上任何别人的身体，我出门会自在得多。

lines.en: : But right now, it’s kind of like staring into an abyss. Or...TV static, I guess.
lines.zh: : 可现在，那感觉就像是在凝视深渊。或者说……像电视的雪花屏吧。

lines.en: : It’s just one huge mess of spare parts that don’t fit together...but it’s still closer to some sort of...indiscernible blur than a monster.
lines.zh: : 就是一大堆拼不到一起的零件……但它还是更接近某种……难以辨认的模糊一团，而不是怪物。

lines.en: : If you saw something like that, you’d try to tune it out too, right?...
lines.zh: : 要是你看到那样的东西，你也会想把它调过去不看吧？……

lines.en: : I’m sure you’d do all sorts of...self-destructive things to hide the truth of how you feel, because that’s the easiest thing someone {i}can{/i} do.
lines.zh: : 我敢说你会做出各种各样的……自我毁灭的事，来掩盖自己真实的感受，因为那是一个人最容易{i}做到{/i}的事。

lines.en: scene imissyou12
scene futabaphonemom11
: The easiest routes always have downsides, though. They wouldn’t be easy if there wasn’t some sort of risk involved.
lines.zh: : 不过最容易走的路总归是有代价的。如果一点风险都没有，它也就不会容易了。

lines.en: scene imissyou19
scene futabaphonemom11
: I...don’t know if you can really understand what I’m talking about since...you seem really comfortable with-
lines.zh: : 我……不知道你是不是真的能明白我在说什么，毕竟……你看起来对自己的——

lines.en: : I know what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我明白你在说什么。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom12
: You do?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: I can’t really put my finger on how, but I do.
lines.zh: : 我也说不清是怎么明白的，但我确实明白。

lines.en: : I think we perceive self-destruction a little differently than one another, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得，我们两人对自我毁灭的理解稍微有点不一样。

lines.en: : Why is that?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么说？

lines.en: : Well, you think it’s something that can be avoided and I think it’s an inevitable fate.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你觉得那是可以避免的事，而我觉得那是不可避免的命运。

lines.en: : We’re all going to self-destruct one way or another, so pushing it back with hard work and determination is just a waste of energy.
lines.zh: : 我们早晚都会以某种方式自我毁灭，所以靠努力和决心把它往后推，只是在浪费力气。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom13
: You’re wrong about that.
lines.zh: : 你错了。

lines.en: : Because even if my destruction is inevitable, I want at least one day where I can see my shadow next to yours and not hate myself for the differences in them.
lines.zh: : 因为就算我的毁灭不可避免，我也想要至少有一天，能看到我的影子挨在你的影子旁边，而不因为两者的不同而憎恨自己。

lines.en: : So I can’t give up until I get at least one day like that.
lines.zh: : 所以在得到那样的一天之前，我不能放弃。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom11
: Hopefully, it won’t end after just one day, though.
lines.zh: : 不过希望那天之后一切不会就这么结束。

lines.en: : To put it bluntly, I feel rather lonely whenever I see my shadow {i}without{/i} yours next to it.
lines.zh: : 说白了，每当我看到自己的影子旁边{i}没有{/i}你的影子，我就会觉得很孤单。

lines.en: : So you can be as negative and insightful as you want, but I’ve made my decision and I’m going to stick to it.
lines.zh: : 所以你想多消极、多敏锐都随你，但我已经做出决定了，而且会坚持下去。

lines.en: : There’s something I’ve been hiding from you, Sensei...one of the downsides from the easier path I took before deciding to {i}actually{/i} start trying again.
lines.zh: : 有件事我一直瞒着你，Sensei……是我选了那条更容易的路之后留下的一个代价，在我决定{i}真正{/i}开始重新努力之前。

lines.en: : And that downside is?
lines.zh: : 那个代价是什么？

lines.en: : That downside {i}was{/i}. It’s not happening anymore.
lines.zh: : 那个代价{i}已经{/i}。它不会再发生了。

lines.en: : And I can’t guarantee it won’t ever happen again...but I can at least say I’ll try my best not to-
lines.zh: : 我也不能保证它永远不会再发生……但我至少可以说我会尽最大努力不去——

lines.en: : Just tell me what it is, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我是什么，Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom14
: An...eating disorder.
lines.zh: : 是……进食障碍。

lines.en: : And this isn’t me asking for sympathy. It’s me telling you because I’m tired of keeping it a secret from you for no good reason.
lines.zh: : 这不是在求同情。我是因为厌倦了毫无理由地瞒着你，才告诉你的。

lines.en: : But I’ve been making myself throw up to try and lose weight for a...pretty long time now.
lines.zh: : 但我为了减肥一直在催吐，已经……有很长一段时间了。

lines.en: : And that’s part of what my Mom and I were talking about today.
lines.zh: : 这也是我今天和我妈谈的事情之一。

lines.en: : She and my dad thought I’d stopped a long time ago, but...
lines.zh: : 她和我爸以为我很久以前就停了，可是……

lines.en: : Well, it’s a lot easier to lie to people when they’re not physically around.
lines.zh: : 唉，人不在身边的时候，撒谎要容易得多。

lines.en: : But...I came clean to her as well.
lines.zh: : 不过……我也跟她坦白了。

lines.en: : Suddenly, the timing of my sex joke seems a lot worse than it did at first.
lines.zh: 突然之间，我那句黄段子的时机好像比一开始糟糕多了。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom9
: There...isn’t really any acceptable time for making a sex joke while a [teenage]girl is on the phone with her mom...
lines.zh: : 嗯……一个[teenage]女孩正和她妈妈通电话的时候，讲黄段子确实没有什么合适的时间……

lines.en: : You’re okay now, though?
lines.zh: : 那你现在没事了吧？

lines.en: : You’re not doing that whole...vomiting thing anymore?
lines.zh: : 你不再做那一整套……呕吐的事了？

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom11
: Right...so...if I...start gaining weight from...{i}not{/i} doing that-
lines.zh: : 嗯……所以……如果……我因为{i}不再{/i}那样做而开始变胖——

lines.en: : I’ve already told you that I don’t care about-
lines.zh: : 我已经说过了，我不在乎——

lines.en: : You do, though. And it’s fine that you do.
lines.zh: : 你是在乎的。你在乎也没关系。

lines.en: : I don’t know how many times I have to say this, but nope. Don’t care at all.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还要说多少遍，不过——不，我一点都不在乎。

lines.en: : Then...why haven’t we had sex yet?
lines.zh: : 那……我们为什么还没上床？

lines.en: : Hey, I’m ready whenever you are. I’ve been holding off because you’re clearly uncomfortable with it.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你什么时候准备好我都行。我一直忍着，因为你明显对这事不自在。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom15
: Hahaha! Yeah...Yeah, I guess that’s mostly on me...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！是啊……是啊，那大概主要是我的问题……

lines.en: : Not “mostly.” I will literally have sex with you right now. I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 不是「主要」。我现在就可以真的和你上床。我不在乎。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom16
: Okay, so maybe you really {i}don’t{/i} care. But I still do.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许你是真的{i}不在乎{/i}。可我还在乎。

lines.en: : Even...being touched by you makes me feel...extremely self-conscious and...yeah.
lines.zh: : 光是被你碰一下，我都会觉得……极其不自在，而且……嗯。

lines.en: : This isn’t really a thing I want to be talking about outside of the library, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 仔细想想，这种事我其实不太想在图书馆外面聊。

lines.en: : Then take the day off and...let’s go for a walk or something.
lines.zh: : 那就请一天假……我们去散个步什么的。

lines.en: : Sensei, I can’t just-
lines.zh: : Sensei，我不能就这么——

lines.en: : You’ve made it pretty apparent today that you can do whatever the hell you want.
lines.zh: : 你今天已经表现得很清楚了，你想干什么就能干什么。

lines.en: : If you can decide to turn your life around and try to become a version of yourself you like more, I’m pretty sure you can survive a day away from your volunteer librarian position.
lines.zh: : 如果你能决定彻底改变人生、去努力成为更喜欢的那版自己，那我敢肯定，离开你的图书馆志愿者岗位一天你也死不了。

lines.en: : Don’t just stand there while I’m taking revenge on you for kicking me out of the gym the other night.
lines.zh: : 别光站着啊，我可是在报复你那天晚上把我赶出健身房。

lines.en: : I’m not just standing here. I’m waiting for you to lead the way.
lines.zh: : 我没有光站着。我在等你带路。

lines.en: : Oh. I expected there to be some sort of verbal agreement.
lines.zh: : 哦。我还以为总得有句口头上的答应。

lines.en: : That’s normally how accepting invitations works.
lines.zh: : 接受邀请通常就是这么回事。

lines.en: : Since when do we do {i}anything{/i} how we’re supposed to be doing it?
lines.zh: : 我们什么时候按规矩做过{i}事{/i}了？

lines.en: : I’m a freshman and I gave you a boobjob in the nurse’s office.
lines.zh: : 我一个高一学生，在医务室给你做了乳交。

lines.en: : Yeah, that was awesome.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那次爽翻了。

lines.en: : It was...fine. But what I’m saying is that we’re so far removed from how things are {i}supposed{/i} to be done that we should just...follow our hearts.
lines.zh: : 那是……还行吧。我想说的是，我们离「{i}该{/i}怎么做」已经太远了，干脆……跟着心走吧。

lines.en: : And today, like many other days, my heart wants me beside your shadow.
lines.zh: : 而今天，就像许多别的日子一样，我的心想让我待在你的影子旁边。

lines.en: scene black
I don’t find much of a point in responding to Futaba as she is clearly much more determined to speak today than I am.
lines.zh: Futaba 今天明显比我更想说话，我也觉得没什么回应的必要。

lines.en: My irrational rage aimed at her refusal to allow me to watch her gym routine has finally subsided, however, and the two of us are now on a journey to-
lines.zh: 不过，我对她不肯让我看她健身这件事的那股无来由的怒火，总算是消退了。现在，我们两个正踏上通往——

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom17
: The...other side of the[school]?
lines.zh: : [school]的……另一侧？

lines.en: : I didn’t know where else to go.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还能去哪儿。

lines.en: : You...were the one who invited me to walk around, though...
lines.zh: : 可……是你邀请我出来走走的啊……

lines.en: : You didn’t even have a plan in store?
lines.zh: : 你连个计划都没有吗？

lines.en: : Every plan I’ve ever made has been significantly less wholesome than walking around town with a girl who just opened up about her insecurities to me.
lines.zh: : 我制定过的每一个计划，都比和一个刚对我坦白了自己内心不安的女孩在镇上散步要不正经得多。

lines.en: : You’re more than welcome to...share a few insecurities of your own, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你也大可以……分享几条你自己的不安。

lines.en: : I’m sure there has to be something.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定总该有那么一两条。

lines.en: There isn’t.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: I am completely secure in everything.
lines.zh: 我对一切都十分坦然。

lines.en: My feet are planted so firmly to the ground that they would not even move in the event of an earthquake.
lines.zh: 我的双脚牢牢地扎在地上，就算地震来了也不会挪动分毫。

lines.en: And if an earthquake were to come, and the ground beneath my legs would crack in cartoonish fashion, I would stare directly at it as my appendages are stretched so far apart that I'm torn in half.
lines.zh: 就算地震真的来了，我脚下的地面像卡通片里那样裂开，我也会直直地盯着它，任凭我的四肢被拉扯到极限、把我撕成两半。

lines.en: There are people in this world who want to become better versions of themselves, and there are people who don’t.
lines.zh: 这世上有想成为更好的自己的人，也有不想的人。

lines.en: But whatever those people decide to do is completely up to them.
lines.zh: 但那些人决定怎么做，完全取决于他们自己。

lines.en: My words don’t matter to Futaba, just as hers don’t matter to me.
lines.zh: 我的话对 Futaba 不起作用，就像她的话对我不起作用一样。

lines.en: We’ll keep existing and keep on fighting our own fights regardless of how much unnecessary support we pump into one another.
lines.zh: 不管我们往对方身上灌多少没必要的鼓励，我们还是会继续活着，继续打各自的仗。

lines.en: Thankfully, support isn’t the only thing I have the privilege of pumping into her.
lines.zh: 所幸，我能灌进她体内的并不只有鼓励。

lines.en: : Nah. I prefer to keep my problems to myself.
lines.zh: : 不。我更喜欢把烦恼藏在心里。

lines.en: : Even after I just opened up about my biggest problem of all?
lines.zh: : 哪怕我刚把自己最大的烦恼都告诉你了？

lines.en: : Is that really your biggest problem, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 那真的是你最大的烦恼吗，Futaba？

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom18
: I...I think so?
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得是吧？

lines.en: : You’re not worried about how each and every day we move one step closer to death? Or how the world is becoming less and less habitable with each passing moment?
lines.zh: : 你就不担心我们每一天都在离死亡更近一步吗？或者这个世界正一分一秒地变得越来越不宜居？

lines.en: : I...don’t think I’m...supposed to start thinking about those things until after I graduate...
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得那些事……应该等我毕业之后再开始想……

lines.en: : Since when do you do what you’re supposed to do? Stop wasting your time and fear them now.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候做过该做的事了？别浪费时间了，现在就开始害怕吧。

lines.en: : Sensei...you’ve given me a lot of...strange motivational speeches...but this one is just-
lines.zh: : Sensei……你给我做过很多……奇怪的励志演讲……但这一次只是——

lines.en: : A joke.
lines.zh: : 一个玩笑。

lines.en: : Kind of.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。

lines.en: : Let’s just say I’m only half serious.
lines.zh: : 就算我只有一半是认真的好了。

lines.en: : If this bulimia issue is your biggest problem, I’m thankful you shared it with me.
lines.zh: : 如果这个暴食症的问题就是你最大的烦恼，我很感谢你愿意告诉我。

lines.en: : I didn’t know and I’m sorry you had to go through something like that.
lines.zh: : 我之前不知道，也很抱歉你不得不经历那样的事。

lines.en: : But there’s nothing I could share with you about myself that would make me feel any better or worse than I do right now.
lines.zh: : 但我身上没有什么可以分享给你的东西，能让我比现在更好受或者更难受。

lines.en: : And there’s not much I know anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且我知道的本来也不多。

lines.en: : What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that this world is incredibly complicated.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，这个世界复杂得可怕。

lines.en: : I can’t risk taking my feet off the ground or it will all just float away.
lines.zh: : 我不能冒险把脚从地上抬起来，否则一切都会飘走。

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom19
: I wouldn’t mind holding you down.
lines.zh: : 我不介意把你按住。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind holding {i}you{/i} down either, but you want to be more comfortable with yourself first.
lines.zh: : 我也不介意把{i}你{/i}按住，但你想先和自己相处得更自在一些。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. It’s not like your...thing would fit inside of me anyway.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。反正你的那……东西也塞不进我里面。

lines.en: : We’ll never know unless we try.
lines.zh: : 不试试怎么知道。

lines.en: : I can’t believe I agreed to skip out on the library to listen to my teacher make sex jokes all morning.
lines.zh: : 真不敢相信，我居然答应翘掉图书馆，就为了听我的老师讲一上午的黄段子。

lines.en: : It’s better than having the sex jokes happen {i}inside{/i} of the library, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 总比在图书馆{i}里{/i}讲黄段子好吧？

lines.en: : Not...by much.
lines.zh: : 也……好不了多少。

lines.en: The shadows of the branches of a tree slaughtered by the harsh winter climate spread out and climb the walls of the[school] building, making it resemble some sort of spider web.
lines.zh: 一棵被严冬气候折磨致死的树，它的枝条的影子铺展开来，爬上[school]楼的墙壁，让它看起来像某种蜘蛛网。

lines.en: Shadows seem to be a recurring theme today.
lines.zh: 影子似乎是今天反复出现的主题。

lines.en: Whether it be the shadows of the two of us or of the dying tree, it’s as evident as ever that there is a darker side to everything.
lines.zh: 无论是我们两人的影子，还是那棵垂死之树的影子，一切都再清楚不过地表明：万事万物都有更暗的一面。

lines.en: Futaba’s dark side managed to emerge today.
lines.zh: Futaba 的阴暗面在今天浮出了水面。

lines.en: But instead of ignoring it like a normal person would, she parked it beside mine and reiterated that there is still joy to be found inside of darkness itself.
lines.zh: 但她没有像正常人那样视而不见，而是把它停在我的阴暗面旁边，并再次重申——在黑暗本身之中，依然能找到快乐。

lines.en: And that the darkest parts of me, which she will likely never come to know, somehow manage to help her feel less lonely.
lines.zh: 而我最黑暗的部分，那些她大概永远不会知道的部分，竟莫名地让她觉得不那么孤单。

lines.en: And here, all I wish is to see a shadow as anything more than a shadow.
lines.zh: 而在这里，我唯一的愿望是，能看到一道影子不只是影子。

lines.en: To see anything at all as more than exactly what it is.
lines.zh: 能看到任何东西都不只是它本来的样子。

lines.en: To live without conflict because life itself is conflict enough.
lines.zh: 能在没有冲突的状态下活着，因为生命本身就是足够的冲突了。

lines.en: But none of that is possible. Especially not with someone like this beside me.
lines.zh: 但这一切都不可能。尤其不可能在身边有这么一个人的时候。

lines.en: She will follow me into the flames of hell and, instead of pushing her away, I will grab her wrist and pull her into them so I don’t have to die alone.
lines.zh: 她会跟着我走进地狱的烈焰，而我不会把她推开，反而会抓住她的手腕，把她一起拉进去，好让自己不用一个人死去。

lines.en: But she is weak and will die before me.
lines.zh: 可她是软弱的，会比我先死。

lines.en: So I will die alone anyway.
lines.zh: 所以我终究还是会一个人死去。

lines.en: Today is going to be a bad day.
lines.zh: 今天会是糟糕的一天。

lines.en: : Okay, let’s go somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 好了，我们换个地方吧。

lines.en: : Yeah...I was wondering when you were going to say that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我还在想你什么时候会说这个。

lines.en: : I like the[school] and everything, but...it’s not exactly fun just hanging out on the side of it. Even if it’s you I’m hanging out with.
lines.zh: : [school]我是挺喜欢的，不过……干待在它旁边实在算不上好玩。哪怕陪着我的是你。

lines.en: : Yes, please continue to say nice things about me. It will soften the blow the next time you don’t let me watch you exercise.
lines.zh: : 对，请继续说我的好话吧。这样下次你不让我看你锻炼的时候，打击能小一点。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. You spent most of your energy on that...scary blonde woman anyway.
lines.zh: : 哦，行了。你大部分的精力本来也花在那个……吓人的金发女人身上了。

lines.en: : Scary blonde- Oh, you mean Yumi’s mom.
lines.zh: : 吓人的金发——哦，你说的是 Yumi 的妈妈。

lines.en: : Yeah, Yumi’s-
lines.zh: : 对，Yumi 的——

lines.en: scene futabaphonemom20
: Wait, what? Huh?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？啊？

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : That woman was...
lines.zh: : 那个女人就是……

lines.en: : Anyway, time to go somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 总之，该换地方了。

lines.en: scene black
: Kumon-mi awaits, Futaba.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 在等着呢，Futaba。

lines.en: : That...was Yumi’s mom?!
lines.zh: : 那……那是 Yumi 的妈妈？！

lines.en: : Wait! Sensei!
lines.zh: : 等等！Sensei！

lines.en: I start walking away from Futaba, realizing that I have already said too much, and begin to head down the same path I take home every day.
lines.zh: 我开始从 Futaba 身边走开，意识到自己已经说得太多了，于是沿着每天回家的那条路走去。

lines.en: I don’t have a specific destination in mind but, if I had to choose-
lines.zh: 我心里没有具体的目的地，但如果非得选一个——

lines.en: I’d probably pick somewhere with a lot of shade.
lines.zh: 我大概会挑个阴凉多的地方。

lines.en: $ futaba_love += 1
$ library40 = True
{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!{/i}
